column1: # N0 — does dropping the has_type / fuel axiom families unblock a row?
# Dropping hypotheses WEAKENS H, so `H AND NOT G` gains models and `unsat`
# gets HARDER: a row that still closes did not need them. Pure measurement,
# no code change. Stratified sample of 24 rows — 12 blocked on the DPLL(T)
# refinement bound (B), 12 on an uninterpreted theory atom (A) — measured
# RESULT: NOTHING MOVES. All 24 rows stay `unknown` under all four
# conditions. The N1 (has_type as a typing judgment) and N2 (fuel as
# bounded unfolding) slices therefore have a ceiling of ZERO against the
# current blockers — those blockers do not depend on axiom volume at all.
